1998309900670398679.text:
> be Jack Zhang
> love math and physics
> learn how to code at University of Melbourne
> age 15: get shipped off to Australia
> dad loses job, family goes bankrupt
> finance day job, hustle by night
> learn to sell - property deals, burger joint, wine/oil trade, Melbourne café
> within years, side-hustles pull in millions

2015
> start building Airwallex
> first products flops, money lost
> second product flops, money lost
> third product flops even faster
> cash burning fast with only 6 weeks runway
> Sequoia takes a $13M bet on you

2017
> rebuild from scratch
> a whole new global payments API platform
> payments volume explodes
> $0 → $1B processed in one year
> Stripe offers to buy you out for $1.2 BILLION
> reject the offer

> 2018: raise $80M Series B to scale
> 2019: DST Global leads $100M Series C
> Airwallex becomes a unicorn

> 2025: smash all records in fintech industry
> $1 Billion ARR (90% YoY growth)
> $235 billlion+ payments volume
> supports 200K+ businesses globally
> global footprint with 25+ offices
> accounts in 65+ countries
> 94% of transfers arrive same-day
> latest $330M Series G @ $8B valuation
> backed by top VCs: Sequoia, DST Global, Square Peg, Visa Ventures, etc.

Jack Zhang for you, ladies and gentlemen.

Living proof legends are made, not born.

What’s your excuse?

1998036891308822541.text:
Wow - payments enablement powerhouse @Airwallex just secured a massive $330M Series G funding round led by Addition, pushing its valuation to $8 BILLION.

Notable stat: ARR just crossed $1 billion.

As a rival to @Stripe & @Adyen, the Melbourne-founded company is focused on streamlining cross-border payments, treasury, and FX for global businesses across 200+ markets.

This new capital will fuel a significant global push, with over $1 BILLION earmarked for accelerating growth in the United States.

Airwallex is doubling down on the US, with San Francisco as its second global HQ alongside Melbourne, and plans to double its American workforce to over 400 employees.

The company plans to grow headcount by 50% over the next year, so be on the lookout for some open roles soon.

Congrats @awxjack!

Now let's get you on-stage at @thestablecon 2026....

More coming soon at @twifintech.
